```python
import sys
import logging
from dd4hep import Logger, loadDDG4, CommandLine, importConstants, setupUI, setupTrackingField, setupGun, setupTracker, setupPhysics, printDetectors
from dd4hep import Geant4

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = Logger("DD4hepSimulation")

def run_simulation():
    import sys
    from dd4hep import CommandLine, loadDDG4, importConstants, setupUI, setupTrackingField, setupGun, setupTracker, setupPhysics, printDetectors
    from dd4hep import Geant4

    args = CommandLine(sys.argv)
    if args.options.help:
        print("Usage: python script.py [options]\n"
              "Options:\n"
              "  --help           Show this help message and exit\n"
              "  --geometry FILE  Specify the geometry file to load\n"
              "  --events N       Number of events to simulate\n"
              "  --output FILE    Output file name\n")
        sys.exit(0)

    geometry_file = args.options.geometry if hasattr(args.options, 'geometry') else "default_geometry.xml"
    logger.info(f"Loading geometry file: {geometry_file}")
    detector = loadDDG4(geometry_file)

    logger.info("Importing constants...")
    importConstants(detector)

    logger.info("Setting up Geant4...")
    geant4 = Geant4(detector)

    logger.info("Printing detectors...")
    printDetectors(detector)

    logger.info("Configuring UI...")
    setupUI(geant4, args)

    logger.info("Setting up tracking field...")
    setupTrackingField(geant4, detector)

    logger.info("Setting up event actions...")
    # Event actions can be customized here if needed

    logger.info("Setting up particle gun...")
    setupGun(geant4, detector, args)

    logger.info("Setting up tracker...")
    setupTracker(geant4, detector)

    logger.info("Building physics list...")
    setupPhysics(geant4, detector, args)

    logger.info("Executing Geant4 simulation...")
    geant4.execute()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_simulation()
```
